links.outcome: Effect of fairness-training strategies on AUC and demographic disparity (ES-AUC) for VTDR and AMD
links.effect: Fairness training raised VTDR AUC to 86.3% and advanced AMD AUC to 85.9% while partially mitigating demographic disparities across sex, race, and ethnicity.
links.quote: Fairness training improved VTDR and AMD AUCs to 86·3% and 85·9% while partially mitigating demographic disparities.

screen.reason: The paper empirically evaluates fairness-training mitigation strategies across demographic subgroups (sex, race, ethnicity) to reduce performance disparities in ophthalmic diagnostic AI models.

primary.practice: fairness-training strategies to mitigate demographic disparities
